Name: Phoenix Fawkes
Author: Phoenix contributors
Description: Shows Fawkes' coarse state on a key, and a key that asks Phoenix to keep the computer awake for 30 minutes. Phoenix always asks you on screen first; no key approves anything.

Actions.Name: Fawkes state
Actions.Tooltip: Shows what Fawkes is doing (IDLE, WORKING, WAITING, ERROR, RECORDING ...). View only.

Actions.Name: Keep awake 30 min
Actions.Tooltip: Asks Phoenix to keep the computer awake for 30 minutes. Phoenix asks you to confirm on screen; nothing starts until you do.
